metadata.description: C4 Container diagram of an extended GCP data analysis stack. Extends it_1_09 with async job processing via Cloud Tasks and a Background Worker, Cloud Storage for file handling, Secret Manager for credential management, and Cloud Monitoring for observability

elements.name: User
elements.description: Analyst accessing the web app via browser

elements.name: Google IAP
elements.description: Google Identity-Aware Proxy. Enforces authentication before forwarding requests to the web app

elements.name: Web App
elements.description: GCP-hosted web application acting as the MCP host. Sends prompts to Gemini, calls MCP tools, enqueues async jobs, and reads/writes Cloud Storage

elements.name: Gemini
elements.description: Gemini model served via Vertex AI. Processes user prompts and drives MCP tool selection

elements.name: MCP Server
elements.description: MCP server exposing the orders view as a read-only query tool

elements.name: Cloud Tasks
elements.description: Managed async task queue. Receives jobs enqueued by the web app and dispatches them to the background worker

elements.name: Background Worker
elements.description: Long-running worker service triggered by Cloud Tasks. Reads and writes data to PostgreSQL and stores results in Cloud Storage

elements.name: Cloud Storage
elements.description: Google Cloud Storage bucket. Used by the web app for file uploads/downloads and by the background worker to store job results

elements.name: Cloud Monitoring
elements.description: Centralized monitoring and logging service. Collects metrics and logs from the web app and background worker

elements.name: Secret Manager
elements.description: Manages and vends API keys, database credentials, and other secrets to authorised services

elements.name: PostgreSQL
elements.description: PostgreSQL database on GCP hosting the orders view and application data

elements.name: orders
elements.description: Read-only PostgreSQL view exposing order data. Accessed by the MCP server
